verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs claim Claude will invoke skills automatically via natural language when relevant (in addition to explicit /skill-name commands), which is the core natural-language-operation mechanism for Skills [anthropic-skills-docs-2][anthropic-skills-docs-25]. However, multiple independent hands-on reports concretely contradict this: users report skills are 'hit or miss', not triggered by expected keywords, or nearly impossible to invoke even when explicitly asked, forcing workarounds like dumping skill content into AGENTS.md instead [anthropic-skills-comm-6][anthropic-skills-comm-7][anthropic-skills-comm-9][anthropic-skills-comm-10][anthropic-skills-comm-12]. missing for 10: reliable automatic natural-language triggering confirmed by independent testing, and resolution of the reported triggering-accuracy gap.
